title: OpenAI's $110B Funding & Nvidia's AI Future — 2026-03-06
description: In today's episode, we dive into OpenAI's massive $110 billion funding round led by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank. What does this mean for the future of artificial intelligence and tech innovation? We also explore how physical AI is currently less than 3% of Nvidia's revenue, yet it holds transformative potential for the company by 2035. Additionally, we discuss Nvidia's cloud AI ally, which is in talks to raise funds at a $7.5 billion valuation, and how Nvidia's biggest rival is closing in on $100 billion in AI sales. Lastly, we touch on Anthropic's impressive revenue growth, doubling to nearly $20 billion in a few months. Don't miss out on these groundbreaking stories.
